headlines.text: Looking back to 2021, when Darby Allin vs. Ten fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.64. It was the first title opportunity of Ten's career. A hard-fought battle for the gold.
Looking back to 2023, when it was Bullet Club Gold's first night in AEW as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.14.
On a Wednesday in 2021, back when Kris Statlander made their long-awaited comeback after just under 11 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
